I am old now, and my back is not what it was, but maize is our food so I must plant it well. If the chief brings me a coupon this year, I will use the NPK and urea on this plot — it is small so the two bags will go a long way. I keep some goats, so I put their droppings on the plot before the rains come. My son helps with the ridging, but for the weeding I sometimes call a young man from the village for a few days of ganyu when my knees trouble me.
